My dear [Mr Moor](/person/1046)
I wrote the paper you asked me to do for the [CQ](/periodical/60) but I am sorry to say it was not good enough, and was rejected. I rather suspected that it would be for it was too long and too like a report. Do you like to have it for use in any other way? I have had an article from Mr Donald Mackay sent me for the [Packet](/periodical/52) for August on the Centenary[^1]
I shall come home on the 16th, and I will then send your books back with many thanks, and wishes I had done it better

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: D.J. Mackey, ‘The Centenary of the Colonial Church’ MP (August 1887) 187-92.
